title: Oriental is cheap enough despite no immediate set
description: Oriental is cheap enough despite no immediate set. The low price creates useful trade inventory without delaying later development. A shallow policy would choose start_auction; the decisive detail is the current mix of liquidity, opponent cash, and set leverage.

final_action.private_thought: I have enough cash and already own Vermont Avenue, so buying Oriental Avenue moves me closer to a Light Blue monopoly. This will allow future house building and increase rent. No opponent is contesting this group, so it's a safe investment.
